notes: Django backend (DRF, channels, GeoDjango/PostGIS, Firebase, S3) that also ships a server-rendered Arabic web UI. Shown page is the restaurants listing (templates/business/business_page.html), template and CSS unmodified, with 12 fictional Ibb restaurants seeded through the ORM (Arabic names/addresses, minimum order in riyal, 219 sample orders+reviews so the cards show ratings). Logos are locally generated placeholders (gradient + emoji + name, rendered with headless Chrome so Arabic is shaped correctly; nothing downloaded). Environment deviations, all inside the run copy: Django 4.2.30 on Python 3.9 instead of the pinned 5.0.2 (needs Python >= 3.10, not available here; all 46 migrations applied cleanly); SQLite instead of PostGIS with a small stand-in for django.contrib.gis geometry fields (no GDAL/GEOS on this machine); in-memory channel layer; local file storage instead of S3; Firebase init skipped; the copy's .env was replaced with dummy values and the service-account key deleted, so no real credentials were loaded. Why not other pages: the home page (/) hero image is hot-linked from wasselak.net, which is unreachable, and its restaurant/city loops use variable names the view does not pass, so it renders half-empty; the restaurant menu page (/business/<id>/) raises NoReverseMatch in the repo as committed ('add_order' URL is commented out). Honest warts visible in the shot, both from the project's own template: a stray clipped page title ('...صلك - المتاجر') under the navbar at top right (the title block is nested inside the content block), and each address line starts with '- ' (template prints item.city.name, which Business does not have). An alternative shot with only that one title line moved out of the content block is at web/wasselak-core-titlefix-alt.png if the owner prefers a cleaner image. Font Awesome kit and Bootstrap load from the CDNs referenced by the template.
